subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should this cleanup wait for a structured trigger metadata contract?
rationale: Current main still uses `description` as the prompt-visible selection signal, but OpenClaw docs also emphasize short descriptions and a separate open issue proposes a new `triggers` field, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow a metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording to remaining bundled skills while keeping prompt overhead bounded.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the canonical owner for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that concise WHAT-only descriptions are intentional and close or reject related partial PRs as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow a metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording to remaining bundled skills while keeping prompt overhead bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest observed history on skill docs, metadata, and product-scope guidance for bundled skills.
